updates.title: System updates
updates.description: Check for new versions and manage updates for your {{product}} instance.
updates.throttledHint: The last check was performed less than 30 seconds ago. Result returned from memory cache.
updates.instructionsServerStep1: In the Unraid web interface, open the "Docker" tab.
updates.instructionsServerStep2: At the bottom of the page, click "Check for Updates".
updates.instructionsServerStep3: Next to the {{product}} container, click "Update". The container is updated with the newest image; all data and settings are kept.

state.devBuild: This is a development build. It does not look for updates on its own and offers none.
state.unknownVersion: The running version cannot be compared with the published versions, so no update is offered. You can find the newest versions on the releases page.
state.upToDate: You are running the newest version of this channel.

install.running: The update is being installed right now.
install.confirmText: The program downloads the new version and checks it. Then it makes a backup of your data, closes and restarts in the new version. This takes a moment.
install.unsavedWarning: Careful: some of your input is not saved yet. Input in an open window is lost when the program restarts. Input marked “Not saved” stays as a copy on this computer and is back after the restart.
install.startFailed: The update could not be started.

progress.title: Update to {{version}}
progress.untouched: Your installed version and your data are unchanged.
progress.untouchedWithBackup: Your installed version and your data are unchanged. The backup made before the update is called {{file}}.
progress.backingUpText: Your data is being backed up. Please do not close the program yourself.
progress.restartingText: The program is closing now and will start again in the new version in a moment.

updates.instructionsServerIntro: On a server you update the container, not the app itself. For the chosen channel the container must use the image tag "{{tag}}".
updates.instructionsServerCompose: With Docker Compose: "docker compose pull" and then "docker compose up -d". On any other server the command above is enough, then recreate the container.
updates.instructionsDesktopOneClick: When an update is available, a notice appears in the navigation. One click downloads the new version, makes a backup and restarts the program. Nothing is installed without your click.
updates.instructionsDesktopManual: This program was not installed with the setup program, so it cannot update itself. Download the newest version from the releases page and run the setup.

channel.title: Update channel
channel.text: The channel decides which versions are offered to you as an update. The program is never set back to an older version.
channel.noneText: Standard: you only get finished versions (releases). This is the safest choice.
channel.betaText: Beta channel: you get beta versions to try out and all finished versions as well. Betas may still contain errors.
channel.nightlyText: Nightly channel: you get every change as soon as possible and all finished versions as well. Nightlies are hardly tested and may contain errors.
channel.notSaved: No channel chosen yet: the standard applies.
channel.dockerNote: Docker and Unraid: the container has to use the image "{{image}}" for this. In Unraid enter it under "Edit" in the "Repository" field. Choosing it here alone does not change what Docker downloads.
channel.desktopNote: The Windows program downloads the package of the chosen channel by itself.
channel.saveFailed: The update channel could not be saved.

dragWindow.handle: Move window: use the arrow keys to move it, hold Shift for larger steps. With the mouse, drag the header.

settings.title: Introduction and hints
settings.text: Shows the short introduction again and brings back the hints on every page.

welcome.title: Applications that look good
welcome.text: {{product}} turns your details into a CV, a cover letter and an application portfolio. You write everything down once and reuse it for every application.
welcome.point1: One master profile instead of many separate files.
welcome.point2: CV, cover letter and portfolio as PDF, CV and cover letter also as a Word file.
welcome.point3: The AI help is optional. Everything works just the same without it.

profile.title: The master profile: keep it once
profile.text: Everything about you is here: contact details, work experience, education, skills. What you type is saved by itself, there is no save button.
profile.point1: Switch between the sections in the sidebar; the wizard mode walks you through them step by step.
profile.point2: Under "Preview & Export" you see the CV as a PDF and choose design, color and font.
profile.point3: The gap analysis shows periods without a station in your career.

letter.title: The cover letter
letter.text: A cover letter of its own for every job. {{product}} fills in sender and date from your master profile; the layout is based on DIN 5008.
letter.point1: It is saved by itself, and the PDF preview shows the finished page.
letter.point2: You can download it as a PDF or as a Word file.
letter.point3: The AI assistant can suggest a draft. Only what you confirm is taken over.

applications.title: Applications and portfolio
applications.text: The application tracker keeps the overview: every application has a status, from draft to offer or rejection.
applications.point1: View them as a Kanban board with columns or as a list.
applications.point2: The portfolio combines cover sheet, cover letter, CV and attachments in one PDF.
applications.point3: Upload certificates and other attachments once and attach them to every application.

guide.title: Guide: what belongs in your application?
guide.text: In a few clicks you find out what belongs in your application in your situation.
guide.point1: Five short questions, about a minute, can be cancelled at any time.
guide.point2: You get a plan: what belongs in it, how the CV is built, what you can cut.
guide.point3: Under "All situations" you read the plans for typical situations without any questions. Orientation, not legal advice.

help.title: Help when you need it
help.text: On every page, "Help for this page" in the sidebar shows short hints right at the controls.
help.point1: The manual explains everything in detail and can be downloaded as a PDF.
help.point2: In the settings you restart this introduction and all hints at any time.
help.point3: You set up the AI under "AI Settings": your own key, a local model, or copy and paste.

overviewActions.title: New application and export
overviewActions.text: The gold button creates an application, "Export" downloads the finished PDFs.

overviewBoard.title: Your application board
overviewBoard.text: Each column is a stage of your applications. A click on a card opens it, and there you change the status as well.

overviewNext.title: Follow-up due
overviewNext.text: The applications whose follow-up is due are listed here. A click opens the application.

navProfile.title: Start here
navProfile.text: In the master profile you keep your details once. CV, cover letter and portfolio are made from it.

navExport.title: Export
navExport.text: Download the finished PDFs of your applications here, one at a time or many at once.

exportTabs.title: Applications or CV only
exportTabs.text: The first tab holds the PDFs of your applications, the second only the CV with preview, design and download.

exportBulk.title: Several at once
exportBulk.text: Tick applications. One gives a PDF, several give a ZIP. At most 100 are possible at once.

exportList.title: Your applications
exportList.text: Each row shows the file name made from company and job title. "View" shows the portfolio, "PDF" downloads it.

navGuide.title: Guide
navGuide.text: A click-through assistant: in a few clicks you find out what belongs in your application in your situation.

shellAi.title: AI Settings
shellAi.text: The AI help is optional. Here you set up how it works: with your own key, with a local model, or by copy and paste.

shellHandbook.title: Manual
shellHandbook.text: The detailed manual, in German and English. You read it in the app or download it as a PDF.

shellHelp.title: Help for this page
shellHelp.text: Shows the hints of the page you are on. On pages without hints, the introduction starts.

shellCollapse.title: Collapse and expand the sidebar
shellCollapse.text: Folds the sidebar into a slim bar of icons so the page gets more room. Point at an icon to see its name. A second click expands it again; this browser remembers the choice.

profileSections.title: The sections of the master profile
profileSections.text: Switch here between personal data, work experience, education, skills and the other sections. "Preview & Export" is at the bottom.

profileAutosave.title: Saved by itself
profileAutosave.text: You do not have to save anything. What you type is backed up by itself; this shows how that is going.

profileAssistant.title: Wizard mode
profileAssistant.text: Prefer it step by step? The wizard walks you through all the details in order. "Classic view" takes you back.

profileAi.title: AI help for the short profile
profileAi.text: The AI can suggest a short profile or translate your text. It is optional, and only what you confirm is taken over.

experiencesAdd.title: Add a station
experiencesAdd.text: Enter your jobs here. They appear in your CV.

profileGaps.title: Gap analysis
profileGaps.text: Here {{product}} reports periods without a station in your career. Under "Show details & tips" you fill a gap with one click, for example with further education.

previewDesign.title: Design
previewDesign.text: This is how your CV looks. With "Choose design" you compare all templates with a thumbnail.

previewColor.title: Accent color
previewColor.text: The color for lines, areas and headings. You can pick a color of your own as well.

previewFont.title: Font
previewFont.text: The font for the whole document. The preview follows at once.

previewExport.title: Download
previewExport.text: Download the CV as a PDF or as a Word file here. "Refresh preview" redraws the preview.

previewPane.title: The preview
previewPane.text: This is what the finished CV looks like. It changes as soon as you change design, color or font.

lettersNew.title: New Cover Letter
lettersNew.text: Creates a cover letter. Sender and date are filled in already, you add the recipient and the text.

lettersList.title: Your cover letters
lettersList.text: A click opens a cover letter for editing. It is saved by itself.

letterTabs.title: Content and preview
letterTabs.text: Write the letter under "Content"; under "PDF Preview" you see the finished page.

letterAutosave.title: Saved by itself
letterAutosave.text: The cover letter saves itself. This shows whether everything is backed up or what is still missing.

letterAi.title: AI Assistant
letterAi.text: Has a draft of the cover letter suggested. The AI is optional, and you decide what is taken over.

letterExport.title: Download
letterExport.text: The finished cover letter as a PDF or Word file. "Delete" removes it.

applicationsNew.title: New Application
applicationsNew.text: Create an application here: job, company, status and the matching cover letter.

applicationsAttachments.title: Attachments & certificates
applicationsAttachments.text: Upload certificates and other documents once. Then attach them to every application that needs them.

applicationsViews.title: View
applicationsViews.text: Switch between the Kanban board with columns and the list view.

applicationsBoard.title: Your applications
applicationsBoard.text: A click on an application opens its details. You view and download the portfolio of cover sheet, cover letter, CV and attachments with the icons on the application.

settingsTabs.title: Settings by topic
settingsTabs.text: Choose the area you want to change at the top.

guideStart.title: Start the guide
guideStart.text: Five short questions by click, about one minute. Then you get your application plan. You can cancel at any time.

guideAnswers.title: Your answers
guideAnswers.text: Your plan is based on these. They stay saved in your account, so the next time you see the plan straight away.

guidePlan.title: Your application plan
guidePlan.text: Cards on the topics of your application: what belongs in it, how the CV is built, what you can cut. The buttons at the end of each card lead straight to the right place in the app.

guideChange.title: Change answers
guideChange.text: Has your situation changed? Answer the questions again and the plan adjusts.

guideOverviewButton.title: All situations
guideOverviewButton.text: To read up on: the plan for typical situations, without answering anything.

guideSituations.title: Choose a situation
guideSituations.text: From leaving school to returning after a break: choose a situation and the plan for typical answers appears below.

guideSituationPlan.title: The plan for the situation
guideSituationPlan.text: This is what the plan looks like for this situation. The assumed answers are above it; they are examples and not yours.

guideLegend.title: How to read the markers
guideLegend.text: This explains what "Rule of thumb", "Recommendation" and the other markers mean. It is orientation, not legal advice.

settingsHelper.title: Introduction and hints
settingsHelper.text: This button shows the introduction and all hints once more.

handbook.title: Manual
handbook.notAvailableTitle: The manual is not part of this program
handbook.notAvailableText: This version does not include the manual in the chosen language. You can find it on the releases page.
